name: What steps are involved in the interior remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the interior remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior remodeling project typically progresses through planning, structural framing, mechanical rough-ins, finish installations, and final walkthrough. After designs are approved and initial demolition wraps up, trade specialists complete framing adjustments, plumbing, electrical, and ventilation updates inside the walls. Once inspections pass, drywall is hung, taped, and finished. The process wraps up with trim carpentry, custom cabinetry, tile, interior painting, flooring replacement, and fixture installations. Understanding this sequence clarifies why surface finishes cannot be scheduled until hidden mechanical and structural systems are fully approved.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process covers design, demolition, structural framing, plumbing and electrical rough-ins, drywall, and finish carpentry through final fixtures.
